# archive

The same kind as `defs`, moved aside. Bean `e8m3`: the owner ruled 2026-09-26 that archiving is a VIEW rather than a terminal state, so an archived bean keeps its status and is still part of the store. Declared because it holds 631 bean-defs and nothing declared it — a present-but-undeclared directory, which the directory checks cannot see because they compare declarations against disk and not the reverse. `check:bean-archive` holds the invariant the ruling implies: every bean in here is terminal, because a non-terminal one is open work invisible to every count.

Part of [Folio Assistant](../../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `archive`, holding `bean-defs`.

_More than 150 files directly here, too many to list, of these kinds: .md._
